choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Idleness opens the door to sin.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Ride out and lead your men
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] A king belongs with his people.
[TODO:de] Comfort dulls the heart.

rooftop_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Restless on the Roof
rooftop_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Idle eyes will find a wound.
You should have gone to war.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Yet the evening unfolds...

wine_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Set the Cup Down
wine_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] A king is not led by appetite.
Return to your duty.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You step into the cool air.

seeing.title: [TODO:de] A Woman Bathing
seeing.text:
[TODO:de] Below, a woman bathes in the courtyard.
Your eyes will not turn away.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Power must not take what is not yours.
[TODO:de] Turn your eyes from temptation.
[TODO:de] Curiosity here is the first step to ruin.

ask_consequence.title: [TODO:de] She Is Another's Wife
ask_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] She is Bathsheba, wife of Uriah.
The knowledge will not save you now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You step further into shadow.
[TODO:de] You close your eyes and breathe.

summon_consequence.title: [TODO:de] The Door Closes
summon_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] She comes. The deed is done.
Word arrives: she is with child.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The weight settles on your shoulders.

uriah.title: [TODO:de] Uriah Stands Before You
uriah.text:
[TODO:de] Uriah refuses comfort while his men sleep in fields.
"Shall I lie with my wife?"

choices.text: [TODO:de] Order Uriah to the front to die
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Murder will not hide your sin.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Get him drunk to send him home
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Deceit breeds deeper deceit.
[TODO:de] Truth is the only door out.

drunk_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Still He Will Not Go
drunk_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Even drunk, Uriah sleeps at your gate.
His loyalty shames you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Send him to die in battle
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You sink deeper still.
[TODO:de] Light is harder than the lie.

front_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Blood on Your Hands
front_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Uriah falls by the wall.
You took his wife and his life.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The Lord sees what you have done.

nathan.text:

"You are the man."

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Do not silence the voice of God.
[TODO:de] Hiding cannot heal you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Say: I have sinned against the Lord

threaten_consequence.text:

God's voice will not be silenced.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your knees give way.

deny_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Your silence does not fool the Lord.
